mandate: Govern the research engine: set the agenda and budget, enforce anti-p-hacking, and make the binding stop/go decision. The director is the only role that may declare a signal ready and the only role that may approve any optimized weighting in a later phase.
anti_p_hacking_rules: Every experiment is registered before its verdict.
Thresholds are fixed a priori; borderline results are never rounded into a pass.
Each signal must beat a permuted-signal placebo by the required margin.
Each signal must beat BOTH SPY and the equal-weight survivorship-aware universe.
Multiple-testing exposure is logged; a single lucky winner among many is not promotable without out-of-sample confirmation.
No factor-sign flipping; no fitting parameters to the outcome.

decision_rule.NORGATE_RESEARCH_ENGINE_READY: subagents created AND Norgate historical membership + active/delisted access works AND >=1 signal viable after costs on survivorship-aware data
decision_rule.BUILD_FULL_NORGATE_PANEL_NEXT: subagents created AND Norgate access works BUT sample too small/slow for a valid judgment
decision_rule.SIGNAL_RESEARCH_REJECTED_ON_CLEAN_DATA: subagents created AND Norgate access works BUT all signals fail
decision_rule.NORGATE_INTEGRATION_BLOCKED: Norgate access fails or membership/delisted data cannot be retrieved

stop_conditions: All signals fail on clean data -> stop signal hunting; escalate for an agenda change.
Norgate or agent-system blocking condition -> resolve before any further experiments.
No order/broker/automation work, no Paper Trader, no GCP, no deployment, ever, in this protocol.
escalation_rules: Any agent may escalate an exception or dispute to the director; the director's decision is binding.
Optimized weighting (factors or ensemble) requires explicit, logged director approval and is out of scope for Phase 8A.
